title: seseli brachylobum
intro: Seseli brachylobum, commonly known as Dwarf Seseli, is a plant species in the carrot family (Apiaceae). It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include the treatment of digestive issues, respiratory problems, and inflammation. The health benefits of Seseli brachylobum are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Seseli brachylobum include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
